engine_defects.defect: Observed artefact, mechanism not established: parcels above the floor collapse into near-coincident clusters (gaps 0 to ~2e-7 H) that grow with time. The M4 repulsion falls for q < 2/3 and vanishes as q -> 0, so captured parcels feel almost no pressure force and the viscosity removes their relative velocity [SPECULATIVE mechanism]. It is NOT the Dehnen & Aly linear pairing instability: the line chain uses the kernel profile W(|y|), whose 1-D Fourier transform (sin(kh/2)/(kh/2))^4 is >= 0 (Mentat). D&A applies to the 3-D run only (slab transform negative for kh in (2 pi, 8.99) and (4 pi, 15.45)). Exactly coincident parcels on a line feel identical forces and cannot separate under any central kernel; there the guard only avoids 0/0. Kernel choice is census A7 (Captain's call); a Wendland kernel is not shown to cure this, since its gradient also vanishes at r = 0.
